title: CASSANDRA-21113 PasswordObfuscator fails to obfuscate certain passwords
notes: Smallest case (3 files, +134/-3); quick loop. Head is the landed cassandra-4.0 commit; PR #4887 itself was closed unmerged with head f98e31937a05 and a different diff, so review the landed commit. The hard issue is from CASSANDRA-21559 (created 2026-08-10) and fix PR #5012: the patch matches only the ''-doubled form of the password, so CREATE ROLE r WITH PASSWORD = $$pa'ss$$ reaches the audit log in cleartext. Lines re-checked at the head: the escape and regex code is at PasswordObfuscator.java:70-76 (the research doc said 73-79). Unlike B1, CASSANDRA-21113 has no link to the bug-fix ticket in its changelog, so the cut-off context is the ticket as it stands minus later comments. Training contamination: the fix and the follow-up ticket post-date the case head, but a model may still have seen them. Recheck per model before trusting a recall number. Post-dates mid-2026.

known_issues.summary: Only the ''-doubled form is matched; a $$...$$ dollar-quoted password is written to the audit log in cleartext
